leads.candidate: Cantonspark's remaining Pinetum specimens: Chestnut-leaved Oak (Quercus castaneifolia, id 3140, girth 4.15m/26.80m), Bald Cypress 'Fastigiatum' (Taxodium distichum, id 3115, girth 3.70m/23.00m), European White Elm (Ulmus laevis, id 3926, girth 3.65m/27.40m), a second Dawn Redwood (id 3927, girth 3.52m/22.90m), Veitch's Silver Fir (Abies veitchii, id 3925), Velvet Maple (Acer velutinum, id 3928), Sassafras (Sassafras albidum, id 14156)
leads.why_not_shipped: All single-sourced from one 2014 archived monumentaltrees.com index page (no individual pages archived, live site blocked by Cloudflare); no second source or age found this pass. Genuinely promising, an unusually rich pinetum, but ran out of budget this pass to verify each individually. Good target for a next Baarn pass, especially the White Elm (Ulmus laevis is increasingly rare due to Dutch elm disease, would be a strong story) and the Sassafras (unusual for the Netherlands).

leads.candidate: Paleis Soestdijk park's monumental tree route
leads.register_id: monumentaltrees 1096_paleissoestdijk (Soest slug, but palace address is Baarn per brief)
leads.why_not_shipped: Access reconfirmed 2026-08-09 by direct fetch of paleissoestdijk.nl/openingstijden/ (curl, http 200): the landgoed (estate) opens Friday to Sunday 11:00-19:00, the palace itself 11:00-17:30, and paleistuin entry costs EUR 2.50 (waived if you book a paid activity/exhibition ticket instead). This is a real, honest paid/weekend access pattern, not a redevelopment closure, so it clears hard rule 10. Still not pursued to a verified tree entry: the openingstijden page and the general site text found this pass describe visiting hours, tours and an art exhibition, not named trees with species/age. Next step is the site's 'Historie en toekomst paleistuin' or a dedicated tree-route/garden-history page (not yet located) or the rondleiding-door-de-tuin tour description, to get an actual tree candidate with a name, species and age before this can verify.

notes_2026_08_09_deepen_pass: This pass prioritised the pin fixes for brn_001/002/003/005 (see data/research/baarn-pins.json) over chasing new trees, since the field-check risk was flagged as the more urgent job. Time remaining after that was spent trying to lift the existing leads above to two independent sources; none reached the bar this pass, so zero new trees were delivered to data/research/baarn-verified.json.

Zomereik (Kasteel Groeneveld front oak, monumentaltrees 19448) and the beech copse (19447/19449/19451/19450): still single-sourced. Checked ivn.nl/afdeling/eemland/natuurgebieden/groeneveld/ (general visitor info, no per-tree data) and looked for an RCE/Rijksmonumenten description of Groeneveld's park comparable to the Cantonspark one that supplied brn_003/brn_004's second source; none found via Overpass (no heritage-tagged way/relation named Groeneveld in OSM) or a direct search. Staatsbosbeheer's own Groeneveld page returned HTTP 404 at the URL tried (staatsbosbeheer.nl/uit-in-de-natuur/locaties/landgoed-groeneveld); the correct current slug was not tracked down this pass. Next pass: find Staatsbosbeheer's real Groeneveld URL, or the estate's own poeziebosroute/Engelse-park-route leaflet, which may name specific trees.
European Larch with embedded nails (monumentaltrees 3423): not pursued further this pass, still single-sourced, still a curiosity rather than a strong candidate.

Cantonspark's other 7 pinetum specimens (Chestnut-leaved Oak 3140, Bald Cypress 3115, White Elm 3926, second Dawn Redwood 3927, Silver Fir 3925, Velvet Maple 3928, Sassafras 14156): still single-sourced to the one 2014 monumentaltrees index page. No second source found this pass either (same dead ends as above); the live monumentaltrees.com site now returns HTTP 403 to curl (confirmed this pass, worth adding to the fetch-blocklist), so individual archived Wayback pages per tree, if any exist, are the only path left, and a CDX check this pass found only the six Baarn snapshots already known (no per-tree pages for these seven beyond the index).

Gemeente Baarn's own 'waardevolle bomen'/protected-trees list: not found this pass. baarn.nl/waardevolle-bomen returned 404; site search on baarn.nl for 'waardevolle bomen' returned no tree-policy links; a promising-looking search hit for a 'Lijst van waardevolle bomen' PDF (repository.officiele-overheidspublicaties.nl/externebijlagen/exb-2024-28512) turned out to be for a different municipality (the streets listed are all 'IJsseldijk', which is not a Baarn street; likely Krimpenerwaard or a neighbouring Hollandse IJssel municipality) and should not be reused for Baarn. A next pass should try Baarn's own bekendmakingen/regelgeving portal (localwise.overheid.nl or officielebekendmakingen.nl filtered specifically to gemeente Baarn) or search for 'bomenverordening Baarn' / 'kapvergunning waardevolle boom Baarn' rather than the generic phrase.
